Markets.title: US stocks: US market rises as yields ease, Moderna lifts healthcare stocks
Markets.summary: US stocks rose as easing bond yields and liquidity support from the Treasury created a favorable trading environment. Moderna shares surged, helping lift the healthcare sector despite Federal Reserve concerns over inflation and potential rate hikes.

Markets.title: Inflation concerns rose at US Fed's July meeting, minutes show; policymakers insisted on rate hike
Markets.summary: At their July meeting, Federal Reserve officials expressed concern that inflation may persist and necessitate future interest rate hikes. Although the Fed kept rates steady, three policymakers dissented in favor of an immediate increase, while investors now anticipate potential hikes later this year.

Markets.title: US Treasury to double long-dated debt buybacks to battle surging yields
Markets.summary: The US Treasury is doubling its buyback operations for government debt maturing in ten to thirty years. This action aims to ease rising bond yields and manage borrowing costs following a sharp market selloff.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities fell for the seventh consecutive session, with the Sensex declining 326 points and the Nifty dropping to 24,078 due to rising oil prices and US-Iran tensions. Analysts have identified the 24,000-24,050 range as a crucial support level as weak market breadth favors the bears.

Markets.title: Estee Lauder bets on fragrances and skincare to deliver strong annual profit
Markets.summary: Estee Lauder projected annual profits that will surpass Wall Street expectations, driven by strong sales of luxury fragrances like Tom Ford and Le Labo. The company is capitalizing on high demand from young, affluent consumers while expanding its brand presence in China and international markets.

Markets.title: Sebi flags manipulative trades during CAS on Sensex expiry day, fines two entities
Markets.summary: Sebi penalized Copthall Mauritius and Mansi Share and Stock Broking for manipulative trading during the August 13, 2026, Closing Auction Session on the Sensex expiry day. The regulator also impounded Rs 3.67 crore in alleged wrongful gains from the two entities.

Geo-Political.title: Israel confirms soldiers fired at car in which Hind Rajab was killed and opens criminal investigation
Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli military confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Palestinian girl Hind Rajab and opened a criminal investigation into the incident. Rajab initially survived the attack to plead for help, but her body was later found alongside those of six relatives.

Geo-Political.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israeli decision not to prosecute over killing of aid worker in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Australia's foreign minister expressed outrage and announced plans to summon the Israeli ambassador. This comes after Israel decided not to prosecute anyone over the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza.

Geo-Political.title: Sacked Ukrainian defence minister calls for presidential election
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine's recently dismissed defense minister is advocating for a presidential election. Elections in the country have been suspended since martial law was enacted in February 2022.

Geo-Political.title: Israel opens up bids for highly-sensitive West Bank settlement project
Geo-Political.summary: Israel has opened bidding for a controversial settlement project east of Jerusalem in the occupied West Bank. This planned construction has been internationally condemned because it would divide the West Bank in two.

Geo-Political.title: South Korea shortens war games with US, citing Washington request
Geo-Political.summary: South Korea has shortened its joint military exercises with the United States. The decision follows President Trump's announcement to curtail these drills due to his favorable relationship with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian man arrested in Croatia over Nord Stream pipeline blasts
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian man was arrested in Croatia for allegedly participating in the 2022 Nord Stream pipeline bombings. Investigators suspect he served as one of the scuba divers who planted the explosives.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry courses. This experiment demonstrated a new method for generating free organic traffic through AI rather than traditional advertising or SEO.

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create various types of digital media. In addition to creation tools, the platform provides features for users to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn this may not strengthen the rupee. The currency's actual movement will depend on whether these financial inflows enter the market or are absorbed by the central bank as reserves.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank needs more clarity on whether high inflation will persist before taking action. The Monetary Policy Committee minutes indicate that further policy tightening could occur if price pressures continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — Unpacking the economics of India's toll landscape, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highways Management Company Limited shows that high-volume corridors and the FASTag annual pass are driving India's highway revenue models. The data also highlights shifting trends in private sector participation across the country's toll landscape.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has increased India's fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia conflict, persistent inflation, a weakening currency, and sluggish capital expenditure still pose downside risks to the economy.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: To protect rural incomes from El Nino and a weak monsoon, the government is accelerating agricultural spending. Spending on farming and fertilizers has more than doubled compared to last year's pace.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research predicts India will achieve a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for fiscal year 2027. This financial surplus is expected to be driven by strong foreign currency inflows into the country.

India.title: Congress Firm On 2-Stanza Vande Mataram, BJP Terms Party "Muslim League"
India.summary: The Congress Working Committee decided to stick to its 1937 resolution restricting party events to only the first two stanzas of Vande Mataram. In response, the BJP criticized the decision by labeling the Congress party as the "Muslim League."

India.title: Tourists Thrashed, Harassed For 2 Hours Over 8-Year-Old's Shorts At Pune Fort
India.summary: Police in Pune registered a case against nine people for assaulting and harassing tourists for two hours at Sinhagad Fort on August 16. The attack was triggered by an eight-year-old child's choice of clothing.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are moving back to the United Kingdom. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled to start school there in September.

General.title: Couple and teenage daughter who died in water off Shoreham named by police
General.summary: Police have named a couple and their teenage daughter from London who died after going into the sea for a swim off Shoreham. The family's identities were released following the fatal water incident.

General.title: Track defect found on approach to site of Lewes derailment, initial report says
General.summary: Initial findings from an RAIB investigation reveal a track irregularity on the approach to the site of the Lewes derailment. This defect was identified near the location where the incident occurred.

General.summary: Israel confirmed its soldiers fired at the car carrying five-year-old Hind Rajab, resulting in her death along with six relatives. The military has subsequently opened a criminal investigation into the incident.

General.title: Salmonella outbreak: What we know so far
General.summary: An outbreak of salmonella infections has made hundreds of people sick. Health officials linked these illnesses to imported eggs.
